note: No production auth migration was implemented.
betterAuthRemains: FZ-A5 EMBED=Better Auth. CMS users must map to stable actorId and never become CRM ACL.

payload.betterAuthFront: CUSTOM FZ — possible as a reverse-proxy/BFF in front of Payload admin, or a later mapping layer. Payload still owns its user table unless FZ replaces it.
payload.actorIdConsequence: Need a durable map payloadUserId → actorId. Dual login unless SSO spend or custom bridge.

apostrophe.betterAuthFront: CUSTOM FZ — Apostrophe @apostrophecms/user is a separate identity store. Mapping required.
apostrophe.actorIdConsequence: Need apostrophe user id → actorId. In-context editing stays on Apostrophe sessions.

native.betterAuthFront: Same Better Auth as Admin. No second user table required.

strapiCommunity.betterAuthFront: CUSTOM FZ — Strapi admin users are separate from users-permissions end-users. Better Auth can front FZ Admin only.
strapiCommunity.actorIdConsequence: Need strapiAdminUserId → actorId. Community has no official SSO.
